name: ElevenLabs
vibe: Warm plaster studio, ink-black pills, and one glowing ember orb

palette.name: Paper Canvas
palette.role: Body background behind the hero, logo wall and section text — a warm off-white that makes the #ffffff cards register as lifted without any shadow.

palette.name: Frosted Card
palette.role: Secondary pills, the active product tab, the text-to-speech panel and feature-tile icon squares, at 40 uses — the "selected" surface that rises out of linen trays.

palette.name: Linen Panel
palette.role: Showcase card, tab rail, feature tiles and screenshot frames, at 33 uses — the warm tray that groups content and replaces most borders.

palette.name: Onyx Scrim
palette.role: Translucent overlay on imagery and media controls, at 18 uses — the glass layer. Do not use it as a flat gray fill on the canvas.

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Headlines, body copy, nav labels and active carousel captions, at 167 uses — pure black, because the warmth lives in the surfaces, not the text.

name: Cursor
vibe: Unbleached drafting paper on a quiet workbench

palette.name: Paper Canvas
palette.role: Body background, nav bar fill, mockup window bodies and inverted button text (32 bg uses) — the warm off-white keeps the page out of clinical-white territory.

palette.name: Linen Panel
palette.role: Feature section panels, logo tiles, footer and file tabs (55 bg uses, the most frequent fill) — it is the workhorse second layer that replaces every shadow in the chrome.

palette.name: Stone Tile
palette.role: Selected sidebar row, install-command field and active task in mockups — one notch darker marks "current" without needing a color.

palette.name: Pebble Fill
palette.role: Secondary pill button fill such as "Request a demo →" (10 uses) — it is the only solid non-ink button surface. Do not use it for card backgrounds.

palette.name: Quartz Knob
palette.role: Window traffic-light dots, 20px circular controls and toggle knobs — the darkest neutral surface, sized strictly for small hardware-like details.

name: Vercel
vibe: Graphite ink on gallery plaster, a single black prism at center

palette.name: Fog Canvas
palette.role: Body background behind the hero, the logo row and every story section. This 2% off-white lets #ffffff surfaces lift without any drop shadow.

palette.name: Paper Surface
palette.role: Mockup frames, secondary pills, header buttons and the onboard-agent pill, with 11 background uses. It is the elevated tier, separated from the canvas by a ring rather than a shadow.

palette.name: Jet Ink
palette.role: Headlines, emphasized story phrases, footer links, and the filled Deploy now and Sign Up buttons, with 52 text and 3 fill uses. It is near-black that takes the edge off pure #000000.

palette.name: Graphite Text
palette.role: Nav links, body copy and customer-story sentence tails, with 92 uses, making it the most frequent text color. Gray carries the reading load so that #171717 can mean emphasis.

palette.name: Pewter Icon
palette.role: Icon-button glyphs, mockup placeholders and tertiary meta. It is the quiet third tier. Do not use it for running copy, because it falls near 3.2:1 contrast on #fafafa.

name: Resend
vibe: Matte black glass under one raking light, code etched in pewter

palette.name: Jet Canvas
palette.role: Page background, section fills, and the 8px knockout ring behind timeline nodes (19 background uses). It is true black rather than near-black, so every translucent hairline reads at full contrast.

palette.name: Frosted Glass
palette.role: Fill for the glass CTA, bento cards and code-window chrome at 4% alpha. It cools the black toward blue without introducing a visible second gray.

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Primary CTA labels and the few inverted fills (29 text uses, 4 background uses). It is the brightest pixel on the page. Do not use it as a large surface.

palette.name: Graphite Gutter
palette.role: Code line numbers, receding meta and inactive syntax (105 uses). It is the dimmest legible ink and pushes scaffolding behind content.

palette.name: Iron Caption
palette.role: Code tag names, muted keywords and comments (66 uses). It is the mid-tone of the syntax palette that separates structure from values.

name: Linear
vibe: Brushed graphite instrument panel lit by one cold lamp

palette.name: Jet Canvas
palette.role: Body background, footer and the gaps between sections — a black with a hint of blue that sits one step off pure #000000, so hairlines and glass still register against it.

palette.name: Carbon Panel
palette.role: Issue cards, activity cards and the app-frame body (34 uses, the most frequent fill) — the first rung of the luminance ladder, only 7 values above the canvas.

palette.name: Graphite Tile
palette.role: Chat bubbles, composer wells and nested tiles inside cards — the second rung, reserved for content that sits inside an already-elevated surface.

palette.name: Frosted Glass
palette.role: Circular icon buttons, toolbar chips and segmented controls (9 uses) — 2% white makes a control that has presence without becoming a surface. Do not raise it above 5% alpha.

palette.name: Slate Muted
palette.role: Timestamps, placeholder text such as "Reply…", sidebar group headers and figure labels (125 uses) — the tertiary rung, which marks metadata the eye should skip.

name: Ventriloc
vibe: Index tabs pulled from a concrete drawer, with one brass button

palette.name: Fog Canvas
palette.role: Body background, the 80px left rail, and label color on brass and ink fills. It is a warm-neutral base one step lighter than the panels it carries.

palette.name: Concrete Panel
palette.role: Leading-edge panels that bleed off the right viewport edge, with 11 background uses. It is the workhorse container, separated from canvas by a 6-point gray shift alone.

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Floating nav capsule, raised inner cards and white type on dark fills, with 11 background uses. As the brightest step, it reads as lift without needing a shadow.

palette.name: Mist Tile
palette.role: A single inset tile inside a concrete panel, used once. It is the deepest neutral recess. Do not use it as a page background.

palette.name: Linen Sand
palette.role: Warm sand surface behind 3 feature blocks. It ties the neutral grays to the brass accent without adding a second saturated hue.

name: Anthropic
vibe: Unbleached letterpress stock, with color pasted in as collage

palette.name: Paper Canvas
palette.role: Body background behind the hero and Learn more grid, plus reversed text on ink (9 uses). This warm off-white removes the clinical glare of pure white.

palette.name: Linen Surface
palette.role: Announcement cards, the full-bleed feature band, nav pills and light inputs (18 uses). It is the workhorse surface and sits one tonal step above the canvas.

palette.name: Parchment Fill
palette.role: Secondary button fill, ellipsis meta pills and pill borders (10 fills, 10 borders). It is the deepest light tone and signals "pressable" without any hue.

palette.name: Carbon Panel
palette.role: Dark search input and inverted panels inside the ink footer and menu (9 uses). It lifts controls off the ink field tonally rather than with an outline.

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Headlines, card titles, the primary-button fill and the whole footer field (17 text uses). This warm near-black is the system's only "accent". Do not dilute it into gray for CTAs.

name: Dub
vibe: Graph-paper ledger ruled in grey hairlines, stamped with three colored product seals

palette.name: Linen Canvas
palette.role: Body background and the gutters outside the 1080px rails. It is 44 uses but covers the most area, and the off-white keeps white cards readable as raised without shadows.

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Content column, product mockups, secondary buttons and domain cards (193 uses). It is the elevated sheet of the system, and contrast against #fafafa does the lifting work.

palette.name: Fog Surface
palette.role: Customer logo tiles, the hero mockup band and feature backdrops (34 uses). This recessed tone signals "exhibit area" rather than "content".

palette.name: Jet Action
palette.role: Primary CTA fill ("Start for free", "Sign up"), the wordmark and the selected-swatch ring. Pure black is the only action color, which keeps the three hues free for product coding.

palette.name: Onyx Ink
palette.role: Headlines, h3 labels and secondary-button text (168 uses). This is the primary text color. It sits one step softer than the #000000 CTA so that buttons outrank type.

name: Letters
vibe: Rounded stationery sliding out of a pale-sky envelope

palette.name: Paper Canvas
palette.role: Page canvas, inner tiles, label chips and the nav sign-up pill, with 68 background uses — the white sheet that every rounded object sits on.

palette.name: Fog Wash
palette.role: Section bands and quiet backdrops behind scroll-driven demos, with 11 uses — a barely-there step that separates zones without a single hairline.

palette.name: Pebble Card
palette.role: Feature card fill behind the "Letters" and "Transcribe" panels, with 8 uses — the workhorse container tone that lets white tiles float inside it.

palette.name: Pewter Well
palette.role: Recessed tracks, pressed states of light pills and the cancel dot in the transcription widget — one step darker than Pebble, used for depth inside depth.

palette.name: Dusk Sky
palette.role: Top stop of the hero gradient (estimated), sitting behind the nav and the 80px headline — sets the morning-sky mood. Decorative only, so do not use it for text or buttons.

name: Notion
vibe: Diluted ink on a white notebook page, one cobalt button

palette.name: Paper Canvas
palette.role: Page ground, nav bar, footer, use-case tiles and the white mock cards inside panels (18 uses) — the sheet every alpha-ink tone is mixed against.

palette.name: Linen Wash
palette.role: Feature panels under "AI where your team works" and the agent showcase (6 uses) — a warm 1% shift that separates zones without a border or shadow.

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: 22px card titles, 16px tile titles and the circular arrow chips (13 text plus 3 fill uses) — full-strength black reserved for clickable headings and the inverted chip.

palette.name: Jet Display
palette.role: The 96px hero headline, 54px section headings and the logo mark — 95% black that softens the darkest pixels at display sizes.

palette.name: Carbon Body
palette.role: Body copy, nav links, hero subhead and footer text (32 uses, the workhorse) — 90% black keeps long reading quieter than pure ink.
